events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
Paul meets the Risen Lord near Damascus (about AD 33 to 34); the Jerusalem meeting about circumcision follows (about AD 49).
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Galatia is a Roman province; Claudius expels Jews from Rome (about AD 49); Nero becomes emperor in AD 54.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written about AD 48 to 49 or about AD 53 to 57 (debated)

teaser.title: Galatians is written
teaser.text: The date is debated: about AD 48 to 49, or about AD 53 to 57.

teaser.title: The Jerusalem meeting
teaser.text: Leaders meet to decide whether Gentile believers must be circumcised (Acts 15), about AD 49.
